text:
Jules: spontaneous idea 1  alfresco quiz + tiny trophy handoff this Friday after work? rooftop at The Annex does outdoor tables and the food truck is open. low-key vibes. :sun_with_face: :trophy:
Carmen: heck yes. what's the quiz format? teams or free-for-all?
Jules: thinking 3 teams of 4, 20 mins rounds, bonus music round (karaoke-lite). losers buy coffee next week.
Theo: i'm in. can we do a 'meme caption' round too?
Jules: love that. meme round it is. bring phones for photo prop.
Ava: can someone start a sign-up? i'm on call til 5 so might be a bit late.
Marco: i'll make a quick Google sheet and drop link here.
ops-bot: Note: All-hands on Friday at 3pm. Office shuttle departs at 6:15pm for the Annex.
Carmen: ops-bot thanks. shuttle sounds perfect.
Marco: signup: tinyurl.com/redwood-quiz (leave team or 'pick me')
Sara: vote for 6:30 meetup in lobby? earlier works better for me.
Jules: 6:30 lobby it is.
Ava: i'll join, might be 6:40. no prob?
Jules: totally fine.
Carmen: bringing a deck of quick trivia cards and a bag of stickers for the winners. :star2:
Theo: i'll DJ the playlist for the music round. requests welcome.
Sara: adding song recs: "Take On Me", "Dancing Queen", "Bad Reputation"
Marco: also, who can chip $2 for a small reservation fee? helps guarantee a cluster of tables.
Carmen: i'll put $2 in.
Ava: me too.
Jules: i'll cover any shortfall. planning to label it under "Redwood Social" when i DM the venue.
Marco: posted full plan in calendar invite  check your invites.
ops-bot: Reminder: rooftop capacity limited to 30 people tonight due to event. Please RSVP.
Jules: OK all, final note: casual costumes encouraged (tiny hats). see you Friday! :party_popper:
